007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.VectorIndex;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.VectorIndexAttributes;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.VectorIndexConfig;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for configuring a Select AI vector-index object through {@link SelectAI}.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
022 * {@link VectorIndexConfig}, and call {@link SelectAI#vectorIndex(VectorIndexConfig)}.
023 * It does not call {@link VectorIndex#create()}.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>To run this sample, provide an object-storage location through
026 * {@code SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION}. The location must be readable by the
027 * credential configured for the vector index and should reference documents
028 * suitable for embedding. When using Oracle Object Storage, ensure the
029 * credential, bucket or object URI, network access, and compartment/provider
030 * settings are configured before running the sample.</p>
031 *
032 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
033 * <ul>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION</li>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME</li>
041 * </ul>
042 *
043 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
044 * <ul>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DESCRIPTION</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_STATUS - defaults to {@code Disabled}.</li>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_WAIT_FOR_COMPLETION - defaults to {@code false}.</li>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_CHUNK_SIZE - defaults to {@code 1024}.</li>
049 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_CHUNK_OVERLAP - defaults to {@code 128}.</li>
050 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_MATCH_LIMIT - defaults to {@code 5}.</li>
051 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_REFRESH_RATE - defaults to {@code 1440}.</li>
052 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ENABLE_SOURCES - defaults to {@code true}.</li>
053 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD - defaults to {@code 0}.</li>
054 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DISTANCE_METRIC - defaults to {@code COSINE}.</li>
055 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_DB_PROVIDER - defaults to {@code oracle}.</li>
056 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DIMENSION</li>
057 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_TABLE_NAME</li>
058 * </ul>
059 *
060 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
061 * <pre>{@code
062 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
063 * }</pre>
064 *
065 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
066 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
067 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
068 * <pre>{@code
069 * mvn clean install
070 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
071 * }</pre>
072 *
073 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
074 * <pre>{@code
075 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/selectai/ConfigureVectorIndexSample.java
076 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai.ConfigureVectorIndexSample
077 * }</pre>
078 *
079 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
080 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
081 * and diagnostics.</p>
082 */
083public final class ConfigureVectorIndexSample {
084    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConfigureVectorIndexSample.class);
085
086    private ConfigureVectorIndexSample() {
087    }
088
089    public static void main(String[] args) {
090        String indexName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME");
091
092        try {
093            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
094            VectorIndex vectorIndex = selectAI.vectorIndex(buildVectorIndexConfig(indexName));
095
096            System.out.printf("Configured vector index: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.getIndexName()));
097            System.out.printf("Description          : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.getDescription()));
098            System.out.printf("Status               : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.getStatus()));
099            System.out.printf("Wait for completion  : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.isWaitForCompletion()));
100        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
101            LOGGER.error("Failed to configure Select AI vector index '{}'.", indexName, e);
102        }
103    }
104
105    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
106        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
107                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
108                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
109                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
110                .build();
111
112        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
113    }
114
115    private static VectorIndexConfig buildVectorIndexConfig(String indexName) {
116        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
117        VectorIndexAttributes.Builder attributes = VectorIndexAttributes.builder()
118                .location(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION"))
119                .objectStorageCredentialName(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME"))
120                .profileName(profileName)
121                .chunkSize(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_CHUNK_SIZE", "1024")))
122                .chunkOverlap(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_CHUNK_OVERLAP", "128")))
123                .matchLimit(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_MATCH_LIMIT", "5")))
124                .refreshRate(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_REFRESH_RATE", "1440")))
125                .enableSources(Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ENABLE_SOURCES", "true")))
126                .similarityThreshold(Double.valueOf(
127                        envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD", "0")))
128                .vectorDistanceMetric(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DISTANCE_METRIC", "COSINE"))
129                .vectorDbProvider(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_DB_PROVIDER", "oracle"));
130
131        applyOptionalInteger(attributes::vectorDimension, "SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DIMENSION");
132        applyOptionalString(attributes::vectorTableName, "SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_TABLE_NAME");
133
134        return VectorIndexConfig.builder(indexName)
135                .description(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DESCRIPTION",
136                        "Vector index configured by the Java Select AI SDK sample."))
137                .status(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_STATUS", "Disabled"))
138                .waitForCompletion(Boolean.parseBoolean(
139                        envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_WAIT_FOR_COMPLETION", "false")))
140                .vectorIndexAttributes(attributes.build())
141                .build();
142    }
143
144    private static void applyOptionalString(StringAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
145        String value = System.getenv(envName);
146        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
147            setter.set(value);
148        }
149    }
150
151    private static void applyOptionalInteger(IntegerAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
152        String value = System.getenv(envName);
153        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
154            setter.set(Integer.valueOf(value));
155        }
156    }
157
158    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
159        String value = System.getenv(name);
160        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
161            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
162        }
163        return value;
164    }
165
166    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
167        String value = System.getenv(name);
168        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
169    }
170
171    private static String valueOrEmpty(Object value) {
172        return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value);
173    }
174
175    @FunctionalInterface
176    private interface StringAttributeSetter {
177        void set(String value);
178    }
179
180    @FunctionalInterface
181    private interface IntegerAttributeSetter {
182        void set(Integer value);
183    }
184}
